ideas.pitch: An autonomous multi-agent pipeline for rapid astronomical time-series anomaly detection using light curve data.
ideas.title: AstroAnomalies AI
ideas.why_it_could_win: Demonstrates genuinely hard engineering by combining fast ML time-series isolation with multi-agent verification, fitting high technical standards of computational astronomy judging.

ideas.pitch: An interactive transit-method exoplanet discovery dashboard featuring SHAP-based feature explainability for light curve dips.
ideas.title: ExoClassifier Explain
ideas.why_it_could_win: Aligns with domain knowledge and technical execution criteria by providing transparent, scientifically interpretable machine learning predictions rather than a black box.

ideas.pitch: AI-powered optical tracking and orbital debris conjunction warning platform for small satellite constellations.
ideas.title: SkyTrace Satellite Monitor
ideas.why_it_could_win: Leverages real-world geospatial processing patterns and delivers a polished, working dashboard that addresses pressing orbital safety needs.

ideas.pitch: Natural language query engine for astronomical spectroscopic databases, translating plain English into complex SQL and VO queries.
ideas.title: SpectraQuery LLM
ideas.why_it_could_win: Solves a major domain friction point for astronomers by turning unstructured natural language into precise data retrieval, matching winning data platform paradigms.

ideas.pitch: A diagnostic tool for detecting and mitigating selection biases in astronomical survey catalogs and machine learning training sets.
ideas.title: CosmicBias Check
ideas.why_it_could_win: Applies rigorous data science validation and bias-detection methodology directly to astrophysical datasets, showcasing high academic and technical rigor.
